summary: First end-to-end smoke test of Operator's Choice. Backend health, products (12), filters, best-sellers, new-drops, product detail, auth (register/login/me/google/forgot/reset), wishlist, coupons (FORGED10/OPERATOR20 reject/FREESHIP), order creation with correct math (subtotal 2998, FORGED10 discount 299.80, GST 5% = 134.91, free shipping over 1999, total 2833.11), order tracking, admin stats, admin status update, admin delete (200 OK), newsletter, contact, 403 for non-admin all PASS. Frontend home/hero/nav/shop(12 items)/product detail (size-L + add-to-cart opens sliding cart)/cart page (FORGED10 coupon)/track order all PASS. Admin login redirected to /admin successfully but tab data-testids not detected.
passed: GET /api/ health (brand=Operator's Choice)
GET /api/products returns 12 items; filters category/collection/price/q work
GET /api/products/best-sellers?limit=8 returns 8 items
GET /api/products/new-drops returns is_new_drop items
GET /api/products/{slug} returns {product, similar:4}
POST /api/auth/register, /login, /google, /forgot (returns demo_otp), /reset, GET /me - all work; admin is_admin=true
POST /api/account/wishlist/{product_id} toggles wishlist
POST /api/coupons/check: FORGED10 (1500) valid, OPERATOR20 (1500) rejected with min-order msg, FREESHIP valid
POST /api/orders math correct: subtotal=2998, FORGED10 discount=299.80, GST=134.91, shipping_fee=0 (free over 1999 post-discount), total=2833.11, payment_id=pay_MOCK*, 3 tracking_steps initialised
GET /api/orders/track/{order_number} returns full order with tracking
GET /api/orders/mine returns user's orders
GET /api/admin/stats (admin) returns counts; non-admin gets 403
PATCH /api/admin/orders/{n}/status?new_status=shipped returns {ok:true}; tracking_steps updated (3 done)
DELETE /api/admin/products/{slug} returns 200
POST /api/newsletter and /api/contact return success
Frontend Home: 'FORGED FOR THE FEARLESS' hero, hero-shop-now, main-nav, logo all rendered
Frontend Shop: 12 product cards, sort-select present, category/size filters visible
Frontend Product detail: size-L selectable, add-to-cart opens sliding-cart with item
Frontend Cart: FORGED10 applied, proceed-checkout present
Frontend Admin login redirects to /admin route
Frontend Track Order: OC2606307665 lookup renders 3 tracking steps (Order Confirmed, Packed, Shipped) and STATUS=SHIPPED

failed.issue: Admin tabs missing data-testid attributes (tab-overview, tab-orders, tab-products, tab-customers). The /admin route loads after admin login but the four tab test-ids were not found by selector.
failed.evidence: After admin login & navigate to /admin, page.locator('[data-testid="tab-overview"]').count() returned 0 for all four tabs.

Add data-testid='tab-overview' | 'tab-orders' | 'tab-products' | 'tab-customers' on the admin tab buttons in /admin page so admin UI is testable end-to-end.
